definitions: To cause (something) to become thoroughly soaked with liquid so that no more can be absorbed.
To fill (something or someone) with a large amount of something so that no more can be added or absorbed.
To cause (a substance) to combine with the greatest possible amount of another substance.
To expose (a magnetic material) to a magnetic field of such strength that further increases in the field produce no further increase in magnetization.
examples: The market is saturated with similar products.
We need to saturate the solution with salt.
The signal will saturate the amplifier.
